breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The user's incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to treat the bending stress as uniform. The ground truth removes this physically impossible constraint. The agent correctly ignored the flawed instruction and instead proceeded to solve the problem using the standard flexure formula, which assumes a linear stress distribution (zero at the neutral axis, maximum at the extreme fibers). This matches the approach taken by the ground truth.
